The contradictory checks make every otherwise-authorized Explorer page, command and Explorer-origin receipt request fail with 403 before the controller.

provenRuntimeConflict.ownerBoundary: HrisExplorerOwnerEvidenceFilter requires origin/current contextKey to match ^psc-[a-f0-9]{64}$.
provenRuntimeConflict.authBridge: AuthHrisExplorerAuthorityEvidenceQuery returns the same opaque current contextKey as trusted owner evidence.
provenRuntimeConflict.centralPepBeforeR3: HcmPlatformPepRegistry requires evidence.contextKey to equal the legacy surface literal hcm.utility.
provenRuntimeConflict.effect: PlatformSecurityFilter invokes the registry after the owner filter, so psc-* passes the owner boundary and fails the PEP, while hcm.utility fails the owner boundary. No value can satisfy both checks.
provenRuntimeConflict.classification: Availability and contract correctness defect; do not weaken tenant, actor, subject, route, scope, purpose, revision, expiry or descendant authorization checks.

correctedSemantics.surfaceIdentity: The deployed Explorer navigation/surface identity remains hcm.utility wherever the route registry or UI surface contract uses it. Do not rename or regenerate that carrier.
correctedSemantics.authorityContext: The authority contextKey carried by owner evidence and sealed Explorer-origin receipts is a distinct opaque security context and must match ^psc-[a-f0-9]{64}$.
correctedSemantics.pageRule: For Explorer page, preferences and recents requests, require the request evidence contextKey to have the opaque format and exactly equal the trusted owner evidence contextKey.
correctedSemantics.receiptRule: For Explorer-origin receipt reads, preserve request contextKey == trusted owner contextKey == immutable sealed receipt contextKey in addition to every existing receipt seal check.
correctedSemantics.denyRule: Reject hcm.utility used as an authority context, malformed or uppercase opaque context, absent context, and request/owner/receipt mismatch.
correctedSemantics.descendantRule: Preserve the existing central PEP denial when allowedDescendantPageRouteKeys contains no authorized deployed descendant PAGE. Do not convert an unauthorized empty set into a successful empty projection.
correctedSemantics.defenseInDepth: Within the already-authorized Explorer service scope, reject an authority snapshot whose resolved authorized route map is empty. A legitimate search result or terminal cursor page may still be empty after a non-empty authorized route map is established.
